title: VTC Boards — List — payload
description: List the boards the caller may see: those whose audience admits them, and every board they facilitate. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

includeArchived.description: Default true. False hides archived boards from facilitators too.

cursor.description: An opaque continuation token from a previous response's `nextCursor`, bound to the caller and the filters; a responder MUST NOT accept a cursor it did not issue.

limit.description: The most items to return, at most 200; the responder chooses a default (50) and MAY return fewer.

Response.title: VTC Boards — List — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a vtc/boards/list/0.1 request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/vtc/boards/list/0.1#response.

nextCursor.description: Continuation token for the next page; pass it back as `cursor`. Absent on the last page — never `null`.
